messages:
Maya: Follow-up from last night's outage: ops noticed recurring tail-latency spikes on long prompts. We agreed to add incident-driven tests: a regression promptset, extended load scenarios, and a small chaos drill. Starting owner + timeline chat here.

Priya: Thanks. I'll curate the promptset — capturing the failing cases plus near-misses. Target: 10-15 prompts, include multi-turns. ETA 10 business days.

Dan: I'll wire regression into CI so it runs nightly and gates merges for critical routes. Can do a fast path for smoke + full nightly. ETA 4 business days.

Leo: I'll extend perf jobs to include seq-length 1024 runs and stepped concurrency (1, 4, 16). Also add a long-tail monitor for P99.9. ETA 2w for infra and dashboard.

Maya: Good. Can we add acceptance criteria? Suggest: regressed promptset quality delta <= 2% absolute; P95 latency regression <= +20% vs baseline for 0-1024 tokens. If delta > 2% auto-create RD-3470 draft for owners.

Priya: Agree. I'll create the promptset under infra/evals/incident-1988 and add golden.json for expected outputs. Also include provenance notes (seed, model hash).

Dan: PR checklist I'll add: test command, dataset path, golden artifact link, seeds, model-commit. Example command: ./tools/run_eval --suite incident-1988 --record-golden.

CI-Bot: Created ticket RD-3470 "Incident 1988: regression + perf + chaos" and linked to board "Platform: Incident Remediation".

Leo: For chaos drill I propose: 30min window off-peak, simulate network latency bump + small model fallback to smaller quantized variant, observe error rates and client fallbacks. I can run first run next Tue 03:00 UTC.

Maya: Sounds good. Make sure drill includes checklist: rollback plan, observability signals, PD on-call aware.

Priya: One note: some failing prompts are sensitive; I'll scrub PII before adding.

Dan: For CI alerting: when nightly regression fails with delta > 1.5% send Slack alert + attach failing cases. For >2.5% open RD-3470 P1 draft.

Maya: I'll own tracking and weekly triage until 3 consecutive clean runs. I'll also add a column in the incident postmortem for "test coverage added" and owner.

Leo: Will add perf dashboards and set threshold-based alerts.

Priya: I'll post a short doc describing how prompts were chosen and grouping rules.

Dan: Pushing skeleton PR now. Assigning owners in PR to @Priya @Leo.

Maya: Thanks all. Recap: owners (Priya promptset, Dan CI, Leo perf/chaos), ticket RD-3470 created, sync next Tue after chaos run to review outcomes. Ping me if blocked. :thumbsup:

CI-Bot: PR ran: regression-smoke passed, nightly full run queued.
